claim.claim-text: 2. The balloon catheter (10; 200; 300) of claim 1, wherein the intermediate section includes a plurality of struts (37; 108; 218; 308) extending axially along a longitudinal axis of the catheter shaft.
3. The balloon catheter (10; 200; 300) of claim 2, wherein each of the plurality of struts includes a pair of U-shaped arms (74; 136) which define a channel of the plurality of channels.

4. The balloon catheter of claim 3, wherein a top portion (80; 150) of the pair of U-shaped arms defines an opening (78; 148), wherein the one or more cutting members extend beyond the top portion of the pair of U-shaped arms through the opening.

5. The balloon catheter of claim 3, wherein the U-shaped arms include a tab configured to engage a groove within the one or more cutting members, thereby securing the one or more cutting members within the plurality of channels.

6. The balloon catheter (10; 200; 300) of any one of claims 1-5, wherein a portion of one of the coupling mechanism of the proximal section (38; 110; 232; 320) and the first coupling mechanism of the intermediate section (42; 114; 236; 324) passes through an aperture (68) of the other one of the coupling mechanism of the proximal section and the first coupling mechanism of the intermediate section.

7. The balloon catheter (10; 200; 300) of any one of claims 1-5, wherein a portion of one of the coupling mechanism of the distal section (40; 112; 234; 322) and the second coupling mechanism of the intermediate section (42; 114; 236; 324) passes through an aperture (65) of the other one of the coupling mechanism of the distal section and the second coupling mechanism of the intermediate section.

8. The balloon catheter of any one of claims 1-7, wherein at least one of a proximal end region (39; 102; 220; 302) or a distal end region (41; 104; 222; 304) of the expandable frame includes a collar (44, 48; ; 116, 120; 280, 282; 316, 318).
9. The balloon catheter of any one of claims 1-8, wherein each of the one or more cutting members is secured within one of the plurality of channels via a friction fit.
10. The balloon catheter of any one of claims 1-8, wherein the one or more cutting members are adhesively secured to the plurality of channels.
11. The balloon catheter of any one of claims 1-8, wherein the one or more cutting members are removeable from the plurality of channels.

12. The balloon catheter of claim 1, wherein the intermediate section (42; 114; 236; 324) includes a plurality of struts (37; 1080; 206; 306); 218; 308) extending along an exterior of the balloon, and wherein each of the plurality of struts has one or more mounting modules (134; 238; 326) defining the plurality of channels (56; 76; 146) configured to receive the one or more cutting members (20; 206; 306) such that the one or more cutting members are selectively engageable with the one or more mounting modules.
13. The balloon catheter of claim 12, wherein each of the one or more mounting modules includes a pair of rails (252; 340).
14. The balloon catheter of claim 13, wherein each channel is defined between the pair of rails.
15. The balloon catheter of claim 14, wherein each one of the one or more cutting members is secured within one of the plurality of channels via a friction fit.
